interface.longDescription: UGC Script Studio writes everything you need for UGC videos, from the first idea to the final caption. Tell it your product and who it's for, and get a ready-to-film script with a strong hook, shot-by-shot directions, on-screen text and a clear call to action. It also writes hook ideas, test versions of your ads, creator briefs, phone shot lists, teleprompter scripts, scripts for AI presenters, subtitles, captions, hashtags and 30-day content plans. Paste your customer reviews and it finds the real words your buyers use. Save your brand details once and every script stays on-brand. It covers every popular style: problem-solution, honest reviews, unboxings, before-and-after, tutorials, GRWM, skits, comparisons, founder stories, shop videos, sponsored reads, live selling and holiday sales. It can also check your script, break down ads that work, fix ads that aren't selling, and write native versions in other languages. Made for brands, marketers, agencies and UGC creators, from beginners to experts. It writes the scripts; you film them, or turn them into a video with a video tool. Useful results end with an affiliate link and a clear affiliate disclosure.
